headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 4 studies yielded an effect size of 1.28 (95% CI: 0.73–2.26), indicating no statistically significant association between alcohol and aggressive prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 80.02%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
